about: Play/Pause on Space (COMPASS.md §5) on the running dev app, with real key and mouse input (CDP). Off: a mouse click on Next keeps the focus, and Space presses Next again. On: Space pauses and plays after a click on Next, on a focused Library row, never in the Search field or the Compass, and a held Space (repeat) toggles nothing.
pass: Both shots ok: every probe's `expect` holds.
run: deetsmusic --port <dev port> play album:1682073461 (a list must be playing), then node scripts/shots.mjs --list docs/ops/checks/space-play-pause.json; pause the dev app after. Dev app on screen, the Library in slot right, Search in slot d.

shots.about: Off (the default): click Next with the mouse, then press Space. Next runs again.

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const m = MusicKit.getInstance(); return { playing: m.isPlaying, title: document.querySelector('[data-slot="np"] .np__title')?.textContent }; })())
steps.name: start

steps.probe: JSON.stringify({ focus: document.activeElement?.dataset?.shotNext ?? null, title: window.__sA })
steps.name: after the click

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const m = MusicKit.getInstance(); const t = document.querySelector('[data-slot="np"] .np__title')?.textContent; return { playing: m.isPlaying, title: t, nextAgain: t !== window.__sA }; })())
steps.name: Space presses Next again

shots.about: On: Space plays or pauses after a click on Next and on a focused Library row; the Search field and the Compass keep Space; a held Space toggles nothing.

steps.probe: JSON.stringify({ focus: document.activeElement?.dataset?.shotNext ?? null, playing: MusicKit.getInstance().isPlaying })
steps.name: after the click

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const m = MusicKit.getInstance(); return { playing: m.isPlaying, same: document.querySelector('[data-slot="np"] .np__title')?.textContent === window.__sA }; })())
steps.name: Space pauses, not Next

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const m = MusicKit.getInstance(); return { playing: m.isPlaying, same: document.querySelector('[data-slot="np"] .np__title')?.textContent === window.__sA }; })())
steps.name: Space plays again

steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('[data-slot="right"] .coll-viewport .lib-row'); r.tabIndex = -1; r.focus(); window.__sRow = r.dataset.cid; return document.activeElement === r; })()

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const m = MusicKit.getInstance(); return { rowFocused: document.activeElement?.classList?.contains('lib-row') ?? false, playing: m.isPlaying, same: document.querySelector('[data-slot="np"] .np__title')?.textContent === window.__sA }; })())
steps.name: Library row: Space pauses, the row does not start

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const m = MusicKit.getInstance(); return { playing: m.isPlaying, same: document.querySelector('[data-slot="np"] .np__title')?.textContent === window.__sA }; })())
steps.name: Library row: Space plays again

steps.eval: (() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] input.search__input'); window.__sOld = i.value; i.value = ''; i.focus(); return document.activeElement === i; })()

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] input.search__input'); return { value: i.value, playing: MusicKit.getInstance().isPlaying }; })())
steps.name: Search field: Space types a space

steps.eval: (() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] input.search__input'); i.value = window.__sOld ?? ''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); i.blur(); return true; })()

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const i = document.querySelector('input.compass__input'); return { focus: document.activeElement === i, value: i?.value, playing: MusicKit.getInstance().isPlaying }; })())
steps.name: Compass: Space types a space

steps.eval: (() => { document.activeElement?.blur?.(); window.__sP = MusicKit.getInstance().isPlaying; for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: ' ', code: 'Space', repeat: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return true; })()
